stem: Point $B$ is symmetric to $A(4, -1)$ with respect to the line $4x-2y-3=0$. Work out $B$ and tap it on the grid.
solution: Let $B=(s,t)$. The line has gradient 2, so $AB$ has gradient $-\frac12$: $s+2t-2=0$.
The midpoint lies on the line: $2s-t+6=0$.

hints.text: Check which of your two numbers is s (across) and which is t (up).
Check the signs when you solve the two equations.
AB must be perpendicular to the line, and the midpoint of AB must lie on it.
